dialogItems.content: Independent Codex gpt-6-astra/max review only with isolated cache, not an inherited implementer session; no product or requirement mutations.
Accept D-A docs-only equivalence: final code/test/build gates are b4ad42aa, while the full guard mock gate correctly precedes classification at6b4295b7 plus four guard edits.
Accept operational desktop task as H1 because the target ran in kingd interactive session1 and still refuses non-interactive callers; reject conflating it with build-owned H2 relaunch.
Do not treat passing native/sandbox tests as proof of environment independence; the direct native contract defines classification.
Keep current pending criteria and TODO state; the second disagreement triggers the existing goal stop condition, not an automatic next round.

R2-F1: The remediation selected the 34 tests that failed in the round-one sandbox, rather than all tests that exercise a native or environment boundary. Two remaining unit tests create real symbolic links and assert native reparse-point handling. Both passed on these hosts, but their success still depends on actual filesystem link capabilities. The fake process runner in the second test does not fake its filesystem. Two additional unit cases locate and read repository files outside their test output, beyond the two source-reading guards declared by D-C. Sandbox success is not a proof of environmental independence. Consequence: Classify the surviving native contracts as Category=Integration, untagged when applicable on both hosts, preserving assertions, or isolate the actual filesystem boundary with deterministic fakes. Sweep siblings by dependency, not by whether a particular sandbox run failed. Resolve the two additional repository-dependent cases with fixed fixtures or integration classification and lane inclusion, and make the source-reading exception inventory exact. Reconcile counts and rerun full gates on both hosts. Keep the USECASE platform criteria and the D-B conditional group unsatisfied until the complete rule is evidenced. Alternatives: accept the current broad claim, rejected because the recorded source and probes contradict it. Classification: Implementer edit

R2-F2: The lexer now preserves interpolation expressions, but subsequent line-based matching still misses an OperatingSystem member call split after the dot. SupportedOSPlatform matching also misses globally qualified attributes and attributes later in an attribute list. These are direct executable or attributed test constructs, not the declared helper or BCL blind spots. The strengthened guard therefore does not implement the stated direct-platform-check contract. Consequence: Add these direct-syntax cases and rejection controls to the scripted mock harness, then make platform matching handle whitespace across lines, global qualification and attribute lists while retaining literal/comment exclusions. Bind the same cases to the real scanner, preserve the documented helper limits, and prove a full green mock gate before the corresponding binding/classification slice and then full final gates. Alternatives: accept the current broad claim, rejected because the recorded source and probes contradict it. Classification: Implementer edit

R2-F3: The self-review says every script designed or run in round two was checked by Invoke-Analyzer.ps1 before running. Start-WinInteractiveLane constructs a separate runner as strings, writes that .ps1, and starts its scheduled task without parsing or analyzing the emitted file. The recorded analyzer commands check the parent launcher and read-back scripts, not the generated runner. Analyzing string literals in the parent is not analysis of the generated program. The disclosed exceptions do not include this gap. Consequence: Correct the self-review and any blanket propagation claim to disclose that the generated runner was not independently analyzed before that historical execution. Retain the original receipts. Analyze the actual emitted script before future execution. A later analyzer result must be described as later, never as retroactive pre-execution evidence. Alternatives: accept the current broad claim, rejected because the recorded source and probes contradict it. Classification: Implementer audit edit
